description.value: Pho North Vancouver is a Vietnamese restaurant in North Vancouver's lower Lonsdale area, serving pho and traditional Vietnamese dishes. It sits in a walkable residential-commercial neighbourhood that is a common cycling corridor connecting the North Shore waterfront to inland communities. The welcoming bilingual greeting ('Xin Chao!') signals an authentic Vietnamese dining experience for cyclists seeking a hearty, affordable meal after a ride.
